I ran all fourteen queries and checked the answers against the data files by hand where I could. T1, T4, T11, T12 and T13 I recomputed manually and they match. I didn't hand-check the rest, though T10's counts match the log lines.

Two of the answers print in a different shape from the others:
- T10 prints with keyword keys (`:db 3`), not quoted strings.
- T13 prints as qlang literals (`:customer "Birch"`), not JSON.

On Git Bash, queries that start with `/` get turned into a path, so I started those with `| /…` instead.

T1: | /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com") | count
T2: | /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) * /name
T3: | /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") * count
T4: | /data/users * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: | filter ~(/state | eq "open") * /labels | flat * (/name | lower) | distinct | sort
T6: | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login)}
T7: | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) * count
T8: | unionOf /dependencies /devDependencies | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) * ([(/0 | keyword) "@" /1] | join "")
T9: | /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | filter ~(/port | gt 8000) * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: | lines | filter ~(trim | ne "") | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(split " " | /2) * count
T11: | lines | filter ~(contains "ms=") * (split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=") | first | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: | lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | ne "") * split "," | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | filter ~(/5 | lower | eq "shipped") * (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2
T13: | lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | ne "") * split "," | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | filter ~(/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~(/1) * (* (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum) | entries * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total (/1 | round 2)} | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2
T14: | ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
